verdict.rationale: dlt explicitly supports pip-installing a DuckDB destination for local, lightweight runs, and the tutorial walks through running a pipeline locally against DuckDB and inspecting the dataset before deploying elsewhere; docs also emphasize switching destinations without changing pipeline code, supporting a local-then-production workflow. Missing for 10: no explicit 'testing framework' or dedicated local-test-harness documentation, and no independent hands-on report confirming the local-to-prod promotion workflow works smoothly.
